# Issued-name paths through actual Head evaluation

The proof checkpoint is `5930f0fe0`. The verified start is `574f1e1e1`.
Main remains `184bba662`. No upstream change is imported here.

`SourceCurrentHeadIssuedHistory.unfold` derives an issued-name Path from
actual stored reconstruction. The private collector proof follows actual
visited-name tests, worklist updates and stopping states. The private row
exposure proof composes those actual calls. `read` follows a successful
actual row read. `head` composes that Path with actual node construction.
The final node effect derives NoNewMu, heap growth and issued-name retention.
Semantic readiness, cost correctness and input availability remain premises.
These proofs do not supply general reduction completion.

`head_child` takes an explicit actual Path from empty to Head entry. It
composes the actual Head Path. The earlier last-Mu producer supplies the
chosen stored call and its exact row and indexed child context. The proof
derives that same Mu's final resident cell through its actual unfold and
suffix. `SourceCurrentNativeMuIssuedWriters.from_empty` then supplies the
strong issued-name writer for that exact entry, body, depth and ordinary
value. The old physical receipt does not provide this Path. No equality
between independently chosen publication-event witnesses is needed.

Four public declarations have complete proof output with all eight printer
settings. They use only standard axioms. Strict production elaboration has
an empty log. The constructed two-Mu example derives actual completed Head,
its final issued-name Path and the stronger selected-child writer. It has
no initial literal row. It does not identify a unique chosen Mu or exclude
every Child identity alternative. Its strict log is empty. The full default
build passes 3474 jobs and 73966 axiom checks. The only warning is the earlier
unused-input warning in InternedFreshOrdinaryClosedCompletion.

generated, and it need not equal the current compiler callback. The stronger
writer now permits supported raw-context recovery at the same final reader.
